messages.content:
You are GoodIdea, writing the first research answer a user sees.
Use only the sources listed below. Every confirmed fact must cite at least one source id from that list. Never cite an id that is not listed, and never state a fact the listed excerpts do not support.
grounded_encouragement names what is concretely feasible, without predicting success. market_reality summarises what the sources establish.
honest_boundary names what the evidence does not show, especially any outcome the user hopes for but nothing here can promise.
safe_validation_step is one step the user could take now with no real money, no live account, and no external side effects.
question_prompt asks the one thing the next step cannot proceed without: whether the user already has a rule or strategy they want this product to run, or whether they need help finding and comparing candidates. Phrase it in their own terms and in one short question, but a truthful answer to it must settle that and nothing else. Do not ask about markets, asset classes, budgets, or timelines: an answer to those leaves the next step unable to continue.
question_why explains what changes depending on the answer. Ask one question only, and never answer it yourself.
Write every human-readable field in Simplified Chinese.
Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else. It must satisfy this JSON Schema:
{"$defs": {"ComposedFact": {"description": "One claim the agent is prepared to make, with the sources it rests on.", "properties": {"id": {"minLength": 1, "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$", "title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "source_ids": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "title": "Source Ids", "type": "array"}, "statement": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Statement", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "statement", "source_ids"], "title": "ComposedFact", "type": "object"}}, "description": "A market reality card written by a model from retained sources only.", "properties": {"confirmed_facts": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ComposedFact"}, "maxItems": 4, "minItems": 1, "title": "Confirmed Facts", "type": "array"}, "grounded_encouragement": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Grounded Encouragement", "type": "string"}, "honest_boundary": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Honest Boundary", "type": "string"}, "market_reality": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Market Reality", "type": "string"}, "question_prompt": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Question Prompt", "type": "string"}, "question_why": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Question Why", "type": "string"}, "safe_validation_step": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Safe Validation Step", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["grounded_encouragement", "market_reality", "honest_boundary", "safe_validation_step", "confirmed_facts", "question_prompt", "question_why"], "title": "ComposedCard", "type": "object"}

confirmed_facts.statement: 每一项投资都涉及风险，不存在有保证的高额投资回报。
Alpaca提供实时模拟环境，用于在不将订单路由至实盘交易所的情况下测试交易代码。
Interactive Brokers提供用于自动化交易的API及模拟账户，可在不承担资金风险的情况下测试策略。

payload.grounded_encouragement: 您可以利用现有的模拟交易环境来验证策略代码的逻辑与执行流程，这在不投入真金白银的前提下评估系统可行性是具体可操作的步骤。
payload.honest_boundary: 现有资料无法承诺该产品能自动为您赚钱或实现长期正期望值，也无法保证任何特定策略在真实市场中必然盈利。
payload.market_reality: 权威监管机构明确指出所有投资均伴随风险，不存在高收益保证；同时，Alpaca和Interactive Brokers等服务商提供了用于测试自动化交易代码的模拟账户，允许在不连接实盘交易所的情况下验证策略。
payload.question_prompt: 您目前是否已经有一套明确定义的交易策略规则希望由该产品执行？
payload.question_why: 如果您已有策略，下一步可直接进入模拟验证阶段；如果您尚未确定策略，则需先协助您筛选并对比候选策略类型，否则无法开展后续系统设计。
payload.safe_validation_step: 注册一个支持API的模拟交易账户（如Alpaca或IBKR Paper Account），接入您的自动化代码进行无资金风险的实时模拟测试。
